title: Stay in Your Lane
style: world jazz fusion, female lead vocal, brass and kora, 90 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Every player has a side.
Cover it. Own it.
In every language, same rule.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Stay in your lane and cover your side
Communicate early, don't let it slide
Stack or switch, know your role
Team court coverage is the goal

[VERSE 2 - Tajik transliteration]
Dar masiri khud bon va tarafi khudro pӯsh
Zud muoshirat kun, naguzor gurezad
Stack yo switch, rolati khudro don
Pӯshishi maydon maqsadi asosist

[VERSE 3 - Shona transliteration]
Gara munzira yako ugovere rutivi rwako
Taura nekukurumidza, usabvumira kurasika
Stack kana switch, ziva basa rako
Kufukidza dare ndiwo chinangwa

[CHORUS]
LANE - MASIR - NZIRA - BAAN
COVER YOUR SIDE - HOLD YOUR LINE
STAY IN YOUR LANE - EVERY POINT
TEAM FIRST - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Kyrgyz transliteration]
Oz chokungdo kal jana oz tarabyңdy jap
Erte bailash, ketip kalbasyn
Stack же switch, oz rolundu bil
Maydandy jabuu maksatty

[VERSE 5 - Belarusian transliteration]
Zastavaisia u svaiom kalydory i prykrivaite svoi bok
Kamunikavannia zaranei, nie dazvalyaite praskakovacsa
Stack abo switch, vedaitse svaju rolu
Pakryvanne kortu iest meta

[VERSE 6 - Luxembourgish]
Bleift an ärer Linn a deckt äre Säit
Fréizäiteg kommunizéieren, net lassloosse
Stack oder switch, kennt är Roll
Teamofdeckung ass d'Zil

[CHORUS]
LANE - MASIR - NZIRA - BAAN
COVER YOUR SIDE - HOLD YOUR LINE
STAY IN YOUR LANE - EVERY POINT
TEAM FIRST - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Tajik. Shona. Kyrgyz. Belarusian. Luxembourgish.
Your lane. Your side. Your partner.
Cover it. Every point.

[FINAL CHORUS]
LANE - MASIR - NZIRA - BAAN
COVER YOUR SIDE - HOLD YOUR LINE
STAY IN YOUR LANE - EVERY POINT
TEAM FIRST - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE TEAM
HOLD THE LINE - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Stay in your lane.
